svg.title: Slingshot — the Layers menu (radiation on)
svg.desc: Planning-mode mockup (WP11): a medium asteroid belt ringing the sun with the predicted path threading two gaps, a gas giant with a radiation belt, the radiation map on (R) as a halftone dose field, and the dose meter predicting the path's dose.
